{{External|rs|rsc=Pack leader}} {{HasTask|Wolves}} {{Infobox Monster |version1 = White Wolf Mountain |version2 = Feldip Hills |name = Big Wolf |image1 = [[File:Big Wolf.png|250px]] |image2 = [[File:Big Wolf (Feldip Hills).png|250px]] |release1 = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |release2 = [[7 December]] [[2017]] |update1 = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |update2 = The Corsair Curse and Wilderness Chaos Altar |members = Yes |combat = 73 |size = 2 |examine = Must be the pack leader. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 7 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 90 |slayxp = 74 |cat = Wolves |assignedby = turael,spria,mazchna |hitpoints = 74 |att = 60 |str = 61 |def = 62 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |elementalweaknesstype = Fire |elementalweaknesspercent = 20 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id1 = 109 |id2 = 115 }} The '''Big Wolf''' is a canine [[monster]] found around the [[White Wolf Mountain]] and in the [[Feldip Hills]]. It is a stronger version of a normal [[wolf]]. It can prove deadly to low-level players who encounter it among its pack. Big wolves do not share the appearance of the wolves in their region. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Big Wolf |location = [[Feldip Hills]] |levels = 73 |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |x:2487,y:2924 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = kandarin }} {{LocLine |name = Big Wolf |location = [[White Wolf Mountain]] |levels = 73 |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |x:2840,y:3497 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = asgarnia }} {{LocTableBottom}} ==Drops== {{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}} ===100%=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Wolf bones|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Tertiary=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Wolf bone|quantity=1|rarity=Always|raritynotes=Wolf bones are only dropped during [[Rag and Bone Man II]].|gemw=No}} {{DropsTableBottom}} {{Reflist|group=d}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 25 June 2025 |update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat |change = Big wolves now have a 20% elemental weakness to [[fire spells]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 7 December 2017 |update = The Corsair Curse and Wilderness Chaos Altar |change = The black variant was added to the game. }} {{Subject changes |date = 4 June 2007 |update = Hair of the dog |change = *The NPC was graphically updated. *The black variant was added to the cache, but was unused. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Big Wolf (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Big Wolf.png|center|300x150px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
